correctness.rationale: For odd n>=3 and 0<delta<=1/[2^(n+1)(nh+2nJ)], the Pauli-string convex decomposition directly proves the constructed joint state is fully separable. Uniform charger outcome probabilities and distinct Walsh characters yield exactly Var(E_B)=(2^n delta)^2[h² sum_i z_i²+J² sum_edges(u_i·u_j)²]. With squared transverse lengths t_i in [0,1], fixing azimuths makes this expression separately affine in each t_i; a global minimizer exists at cube vertices t_i in {0,1}. Any vertical vertex gives >=h², attained by orthogonal alternation along the resulting path. Otherwise double-angle vectors on the odd n-cycle give least adjacency eigenvalue -2 cos(pi/n), with an attainable Fourier mode; equatorial minimum equals nJ²[1-cos(pi/n)]/2. Thus exactly the claimed smaller branch and switch, with all-axis global coverage. The bipartite iff zero statement uses h,J>0 and two perpendicular planar unoriented lines. Independent deterministic optimizer and variance checks on odd n=3,5,7,9,11 corroborated construction, not the infinite spectral proof. The n=3, h=J=1, delta=1/256 witness yields 3/4096 squared-energy dispersion.
